title: Four Orders on the Back Shelf
story: Rosa's order book is her pride, second only to Gloria, her oldest sourdough starter. On Friday morning four special orders waited on the back shelf at Salt & Sugar, among them a cinnamon bun the size of a dinner plate, and four customers came to collect them, each at a different hour. In the rush, Rosa never wrote down who took what. Can you set her book straight before the next rush?

texts: Of Zeke and the 10 a.m. customer, one ordered the rye loaf and the other ordered the cinnamon bun.
Of the 7 a.m. customer and the 10 a.m. customer, one ordered the rye loaf and the other ordered the layer cake.
Lou came in earlier than the customer with the baguettes.
Zeke came in later than the customer with the baguettes.
Nico did not order the baguettes.

trace.text: Clue 3 means Lou cannot be 10 a.m. and the baguettes cannot be 7 a.m.
The baguettes must go with Milo: clue 5 rules out Nico; clue 4 rules out Zeke; clue 3 rules out Lou.
Since the baguettes can still be only 8 a.m., 9 a.m., or 10 a.m., clue 4 means the baguettes cannot be 10 a.m. and Zeke cannot be 7 a.m. or 8 a.m.
Since Lou can still be only 7 a.m., 8 a.m., or 9 a.m. and the baguettes can still be only 8 a.m. or 9 a.m., clue 3 means Lou cannot be 9 a.m.
Clue 1 limits the choices (mark the X's it gives).
Zeke must go with 9 a.m.: clue 4 rules out 7 a.m. and 8 a.m.; clue 1 rules out 10 a.m.
Milo must go with 8 a.m.: 7 a.m. and 10 a.m. are already ruled out for the baguettes; 9 a.m. already goes with Zeke.
Lou must go with 7 a.m.: clue 3 rules out 9 a.m. and 10 a.m.; 8 a.m. already goes with Milo.
Nico must go with 10 a.m.: the other choices are already taken.
The baguettes goes with Milo, so the baguettes also goes with 8 a.m.
The layer cake must go with 7 a.m.: clue 1 rules out 10 a.m.; 9 a.m. is already ruled out for Zeke; 8 a.m. already goes with the baguettes.
Lou goes with 7 a.m., so Lou also goes with the layer cake.
Clue 2 limits the choices (mark the X's it gives).
The rye loaf must go with 10 a.m.: clue 2 rules out 9 a.m.; the other choices are already taken.
The cinnamon bun must go with 9 a.m.: clue 2 rules out 10 a.m.; the other choices are already taken.
Zeke must go with the cinnamon bun: clue 1 rules out the layer cake; clue 4 rules out the baguettes; the rye loaf is already ruled out for 9 a.m.
Nico must go with the rye loaf: clue 5 rules out the baguettes; the other choices are already taken.
